label: Log incoming WhatsApp messages to a file
info: Keeps a CSV record of every WhatsApp message you receive: time, sender, kind and the start of the text.

name: START HERE: setup in 3 steps (select this note)
info:
**Setup in 3 steps** (once, about five minutes)

1. **Link your WhatsApp number.** In the [Turbo Notify dashboard](https://dashboard.turbonotify.com) create an account if you have none (it is free), then open **Numbers** and connect your WhatsApp number. First time? Follow the [step by step guide](https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/guides/quickstart/).
2. **Create an API key.** Open **API keys** and create one with the **AI agent (MCP)** template. Copy it, it is shown only once. This flow uses the scope events:read.
3. **Paste it here.** Double-click a whatsapp node of this flow, click the pencil next to **Account**, paste the key and press **Test**. It tells you whether the key works and whether your number is linked.

**About this flow.** The file node appends a line per message to whatsapp-messages.csv in the folder where Node-RED runs: change the path in the file node. Keep the file private, it holds your customers' numbers. A message that starts with = + - or @ is saved with a quote in front, so a spreadsheet shows it as text and never runs it. The events node listens to message.received and message.replied: a person who swipes to reply to one of your messages arrives as message.replied.
